results.name: ACS IT Support
results.notes: All four top issues re-verified on the live site today. No GBP: a Maps search for 'ACS IT Support East Brunswick NJ' returns only unrelated ACS-named businesses (ACS Investigations, ACS Cleaning, ACS Logistics); the firm has no listing. Title is 'ACS IT SUPPORT - ACS IT SUPPORT', meta description absent, zero H1 elements, zero ld+json blocks. At 390px the first screen is a blank white hero under the logo - the same blank slider is visible at 1440px, so the problem is at least as bad as described. Contact page: two Contact Form 7 forms, every visible field placeholder-only with no label element and no aria-label, reCAPTCHA v2 iframe present, plus a Calendly 30min inline embed at calendly.com/acsitsupport/30min and a clickconnector chat widget. Footer reads 'Copyright 2024(c) ACS IT SUPPORT, Inc'. robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /wp-admin/ / Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php' with /wp-sitemap.xml, so AI crawlers are not blocked. tel:732.385.8000 works (icon only at mobile width). Scores accepted: no GBP plus no meta, H1 or hero is a large, cheap-to-close gap (gap_size 4); an MSP selling SMB retainers with a suite/mailbox address justifies ability_to_pay 3; ease 4 for standard GBP and SEO work; evidence 4 since every claim is directly observable.

results.name: Minieri Realty LLC
results.notes: Operating, but reachable only through portals. The GBP Minieri Realty is live at 735 Georges Rd, North Brunswick Township, category Real estate agency, 'Open - Closes 9 PM', phone (732) 354-1957 - and it still points roysellsnj.com at prospects as the website link. That domain fails in Chrome today with net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED, confirming the record's central claim, while search indexes still return roysellsnj.com URLs (home, /agents/roy-minieri/, /local-resources/), so the domain lapsed rather than never existing. No replacement site exists: searches surface only the dead domain, portal and directory profiles. The record's listing data (realtor.com 5.0 from 8 reviews) could not be reopened - realtor.com returned HTTP 429 and the Nestfully office page serves a Cloudflare bot check - but nothing contradicts it, and GBP shows no rating of its own. Scores accepted: site down is the maximal gap (5), a one-broker shop caps ability_to_pay at 2, restore plus lead response is straightforward (ease 4), evidence is directly observable (4). Worth adding for the owner: the GBP is actively sending prospects to a dead domain, which makes a minimal rebuild more urgent than 'no site' implies.

It has a real hero H1 (Transform Your Space With Color), a meta description, about 6,300 characters of body copy, nine services written out, an About section naming owner Brian G., an Our Work gallery of six described jobs, a Yelp 5.0 reviews block, and two ld+json blocks - a HousePainter/PostalAddress graph with Service and Offer entries plus an FAQPage. Genuine remaining gaps are narrow: the Birdeye profile is unclaimed, review volume is thin (8 reviews at 4.6 against the Yelp 5.0 the site leads with), the site is single-page with no per-service or service-area pages, and there is no robots.txt or sitemap. That is a small engagement for a one-person owner-operator shop, so gap_size drops 5 to 2, ease 5 to 3 (the easy build is done), ability_to_pay stays 2, and evidence drops 3 to 1 because the record's central factual claim about the website is false - consistent with stale or misattributed research rather than an inspection of this business.

littlespringmontessori.com could not be loaded in any form (TLS hostname mismatch over https, other http variants blocked before load), so its robots.txt, schema and page content remain unchecked beyond search-index snippets.
